notes: Signal marks are 72.10 / 70.10 m; 80.30 / 78.30 m are reserved nose limits. The whole reservation starts at 56 / 54 m, exactly beyond each turnout and line 1 cart leg.

Line 1 has its full three-car consist on the ridge bridge approach/trestle; line 2 has the six-car long-boiler train on its bank/rising approach. Neither held train spans the Home foot crossing or spur points.
Line 2 Home service mark 2.9332858088509566 m is distinct from its held signal. Cart and running trains are phase-exclusive (R1a).
